/// <summary>
/// The translations contract declared by <see cref="ShopTranslationsEN"/>: one member per text, for one language.
/// Every language in <c>[assembly: SupportedLanguages]</c> implements it, named with its language as suffix, and the build
/// reports a language without a set. Because every member must be implemented, a text without a translation is a
/// compile error rather than a fallback at run time. Each set registers itself, so there is nothing to register.
/// </summary>
public interface IShopTranslations : CodeChops.Idioma.ITranslations
{
    /// <inheritdoc cref="ShopTranslationsEN.Checkout"/>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Translations:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item><description><see cref="ShopTranslationsEN.Checkout">en</see></description></item>
    /// <item><description><see cref="ShopTranslationsNL.Checkout">nl</see></description></item>
    /// </list>
    /// </remarks>
    [CodeChops.Idioma.Internals.FormatPlaceholders()]
    string Checkout { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Total
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Translations:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item><description><see cref="ShopTranslationsEN.Total">en</see></description></item>
    /// <item><description><see cref="ShopTranslationsNL.Total">nl</see></description></item>
    /// </list>
    /// </remarks>
    [CodeChops.Idioma.Internals.FormatPlaceholders()]
    string Total { get; }
}
